description: Memo values by length and by compressibility: ASCII memos of 62, 64 and 66 characters, then 4078 and 4082 ASCII characters, then 2040 characters of U+20AC (two bytes each, not compressible). Asks where each memo changes form and how compressed and wide text differ in the closed file. Typed values and FieldSize are read back. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it.
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2-pres-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
